description.value: This is an On the Run convenience store and restaurant operating at a Chevron station in Courtenay, BC, open around the clock every day of the week. It offers fuel, a convenience store, and a restaurant under one roof, making it a reliable all-hours resupply stop on Vancouver Island. Touring cyclists will find food, washrooms, and a compressed-air station on site.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is from an 'On the Run' Chevron-branded convenience store, confirming the OSM address (600 Ryan Rd, Courtenay) but not the OSM name 'Town Pantry' — the URL discovery notes already flag this name change. The website explicitly lists amenities including 'Convenience store', 'Restaurant', 'Washrooms', and 'Air', all of which are used as primary evidence. No bike-specific parking or water refill amenities are mentioned.
concerns: OSM name 'Town Pantry' does not match current operator 'On the Run' (Chevron-branded chain). URL discovery notes flag this as an outdated OSM name. OSM record should be updated.
Website does not display a phone number for this location, so the OSM phone (+1-250-338-1722) could not be confirmed.
URL was discovered externally (medium confidence) and is not present in OSM tags, so website-to-OSM confirmation is limited.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible 24-hour convenience store and restaurant at a Chevron station, confirmed by website content. Useful resupply point for touring cyclists.
